text:
kara: Thanks all — quick follow-up from today’s all-hands. Can someone drop the RCA link for last week’s reliability incident and list the concrete action owners?

matt: RCA posted here: https://redwood-internal/rca/INC-2026-disk-saturation — short summary: unexpected scheduler bug + disk-pressure cascading into model workers. Root cause: race in GC+snapshot code. Impact window ~12m, elevated 5xx for a subset of requests.

raj: Thanks — is the error budget for Hosted API hit for any customers? need to flag any compensations.

matt: No customer-level error-budget exhaustion; internal SLOs tripped briefly on p95 latency. We did notify enterprise accounts in the affected regions.

devon: For the rollout plan: do we revert the recent scheduler change or ship a patch? timeline?

matt: Patch is ready, rolling to canary now. If canary green in 30m, we’ll rollout to prod in staged waves over 2 hours. Revert fallback prepared if regressions seen.

sam-sre: Action items I captured during RCA review meeting:
- A1: Fix GC/snapshot race (owner: @devon) — deliver patch + test by 2026-04-05.
- A2: Add automatic disk-pressure alert with playbook link (owner: @sam-sre) — by 2026-04-01.
- A3: Add canary gating for scheduler commits (owner: @raj) — proposal PR by 2026-03-30.
- A4: Postmortem notes + customer notif copy (owner: @kara) — by EOD tomorrow.
Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept, or comment if dates need adjusting.

kara: I’ll draft the customer notification and pin it to #all-hands once ready.

devon: Taking A1. 2026-04-05 is OK but I’ll try for 2026-04-03. Will post a WIP PR today.

raj: A3 accepted. I’ll open the gating PR and a small CI job to verify canary health metrics. Target 2026-03-30.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary deploy started for svc=scheduler at 2017654500. Canary hosts: canary-01..03.

matt: Quick roadmap clarification — the reliability work from the all-hands (priority projects: scheduler hardening, KV cache stability, and observability retention) is being moved up in Q2. We’ll allocate two extra backend engs to the reliability squad for the quarter.

anna: Leadership note: we prioritize customer-facing reliability and faster RCA-to-patch cycles. If teams need help reprioritizing sprint work, ping me and Kara for coordination with PM leads.

kara: @devon @raj @sam-sre please confirm when your PRs/alerts are linked here. I’ll update the action tracker and follow up in tomorrow’s standup.

sam-sre: Confirmed — I’ll post the alert playbook link once I finish drafting (target 2026-04-01).

matt: Adding the RCA link to the all-hands summary doc now. Thanks everyone for rapid follow-through.

kara: Closing thread — keep updates inline here so we have a single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
